profile.title: Computational Building Designer & BIM Engineering Specialist
profile.tagline: Integrating parametric geometry, automated BIM-to-BEM interoperability pipelines, and multi-objective environmental optimization for high-performance sustainable architecture.

projects.title: BIM-to-BEM Interoperability & EnergyPlus Calibration
projects.subtitle: Automated gbXML Thermal Validation Pipeline & Optimization
projects.summary: Graduate research resolving geometric distortion and thermal zoning disconnects between Autodesk Revit and EnergyPlus. Implemented an automated gbXML validation workflow slashing topological error to below 5%, coupled with NSGA-II genetic algorithms to balance sDA/ASE daylighting against cooling energy.

details.concept: Bridging architectural BIM and thermal simulation (BEM). By scripting automated Revit API analytical space boundaries, the framework resolves non-manifold surface geometry prior to EnergyPlus simulation.
details.materials: Autodesk Revit API, EnergyPlus, Python, gbXML Schema, NSGA-II Multi-Objective Optimization.
details.awards: 15%–25% Simulated Building Energy Savings | Benchmarked to LEED EAc2 & Taiwan BERS

items.title: Microclimate & Wind Comfort Analysis
items.summary: Early-stage environmental simulation using Autodesk Forma to evaluate pedestrian wind comfort and solar radiation, reducing peak cooling loads by 12%.

items.title: Multidisciplinary BIM Federation
items.summary: Federated architectural, structural, and MEP models, resolving over 120 critical spatial conflicts prior to construction documentation.

items.title: Revit API Boundary Automation
items.summary: Custom Python scripts extracting thermal boundaries and automating space cleanup, reducing model prep time by 60%.

projects.title: Songshan Solo Architectural Graduation Exhibition
projects.subtitle: Curator & Digital Fabrication Lead at Songshan Cultural Park
projects.location: Songshan Cultural and Creative Park (松菸), Taipei
projects.summary: Independently planned, designed, and curated a solo architectural graduation exhibition showcasing parametric digital fabrication models, CNC-milled spatial assemblies, and environmental design methodologies to over 500 visitors and industry experts.

details.concept: Exhibiting the dialogue between digital computational algorithms and physical joinery tectonics across complex spatial geometry.
details.materials: Laser-cut acrylic, 5-axis CNC-milled acoustic panels, 3D printed PLA spatial tessellations.
details.awards: Attracted 500+ attendees and architectural industry professionals
